acceptance: The reviewer flags a finding pre-existing and judges its severity; Theseus applies its mechanical eligibility checks (flagged pre-existing, not Critical, no added lines in the span, file not new/renamed/binary/symlinked, every cited location unchanged, complete finding list, not a promotion review, not DO NOT SHIP, at most 5 per review). Findings that pass are moved to a known-defects list and do not block; anything else blocks.
Critical findings always block, pre-existing or not; High/Medium/Low pre-existing findings that pass the checks are logged and do not block.

Known defects are recorded durably as one JSON file per defect under known/ on the tracker state branch, written only by a trusted BenchBox job from develop via a tractable command; deduped by finding fingerprint; closed by a `Fixes-known: kd-...` line in a merged PR or a resolve_known tool; agents can list and show them.

Tests pin each disguised-new-defect case both ways (blocking when the finding cites the trigger or touches a changed line; known when uncited), a genuine base defect logged and not blocking, and a Critical base defect blocking.
Shipped in Theseus (after the combined release), tractable 1.2.0, and adopted by BenchBox with pre_existing: known and the merge-digest fix.

description: Owner rule 2026-11-09: the reviewer must be able to identify that a defect was pre-existing and not created by the current change. Such findings are logged as known defects for later follow-up and do not block the PR, UNLESS the defect is Critical, which still blocks. Theseus #45 added advisory demotion, but the #4062 review (D4) found it accepted unchanged line spans without proving the behaviour existed at the base, and #54 removes demotion entirely (every finding blocks). This item designs and ships a provable mechanism.
